acceptance_commands.summary: Typecheck passed after the seven final-audit corrections.
Reconciled 65 unique accounts, 499 evidence rows, 12 baselines, 30/8/27 proposals, and 576 blocked with zero ready or unmapped.
Whitespace check passed for the final five-file leased diff.

builder.behavior_impact: None; review documentation and a read-only verifier only.
builder.logic_impact: None; no generation, review, publishing, or canonical ledger logic changed.
risks: The verifier intentionally fails closed on any lane status-shape, summary readiness, bridge-total, proposal wording, or authorization change.
All placeholder and scope values remain staging facts, not reviewed metadata.
unresolved_items: All 576 staged rows remain blocked pending Muxin's decisions.
Stable IDs, account references, baseline gaps, pool choices, and canonical-data authority remain at the human gate.

findings: High: verify.mjs does not assert lane or summary blocked, ready, and unmapped counts or all explicit row status fields; an empty invalid-status branch permits invalid evidence statuses, so the verifier is not fully fail-closed.

Medium: verified-facts-vs-unknowns.md says topics, focus, and nicheLabel are null for all 65 accounts, but all three Threads accounts use unknown for those fields and format. Null semantics are flattened.
Medium: verified-facts-vs-unknowns.md says all 14 professional profile lookups were blocked, while the lane packet records 11 partial results and 3 blocked Threads lookups.
Low: verified-facts-vs-unknowns.md includes a 345-of-371 catalog figure outside the task's allowed three-lane sources, contradicting its traceability claim.

Passing checks: five-file lease, 65 unique disjoint account keys, 499 sources, 12 baselines, 576 blocked rows, 30/8/27 proposals, body-free output, bounded usable decision sheet, no em dashes, npm run check, current verifier, and git diff --check.

High: verified-facts-vs-unknowns.md claims disposition pending on all 499 evidence rows, but evidence rows have no disposition field; text and visual status/reviewStatus are null, while professional status is blocked and reviewStatus pending.

High: verified-facts-vs-unknowns.md flattens professional audience and scope fields to null. Professional accounts and evidence use explicit unknown and local-corpus scope values recorded by that lane.
Medium: morning-review.md calls local source/evidence counts already-published counts, while the lane packets describe them as local source records.

Passing checks: fully fail-closed verifier and both negative mutations, 65/499/12 totals, 576 blocked with zero ready/unmapped, 30/8/27 proposals, five-file lease, actual professional 14-unknown and 11-partial/3-blocked semantics, body-free authority denials, no outside catalog figure, no em dashes, npm run check, exact verifier, and git diff --check.
Medium: 12 baselines are described as one-to-one with 6 accounts, but the actual mapping is two rows per account and therefore many-to-one.
Medium: text/visual audience wording treats absent cross-type fields as null; account rows carry audienceSnapshot null and evidence rows carry audienceSizeSnapshot null.
Medium: visual account cross-reference resolution comes from accountId platform|handle; sourceId/postId resolve source identifiers, not the account join.
Low: every row stays pending or blocked is ambiguous because text/visual evidence and baselines have null status/reviewStatus; qualify account disposition separately from readiness.
Medium: verify.mjs permits either null or blocked/pending in every evidence lane; it must enforce text/visual null/null and professional blocked/pending lane-specifically.
Medium: verify.mjs does not enforce per-category readiness fields in summary.json; a mutation of text-community accounts.ready passes.
Low: verify.mjs does not validate ledger-bridge counts.total.
Passing checks: existing verifier, two earlier negative tests, all fixed totals and authority denials, npm run check, git diff --check, exact five-file lease, body-free output, and no em dashes.

Every numeric and semantic claim in the three human-facing files independently matches the allowed lane artifacts, including joins, identifiers, field presence, null/absent/unknown distinctions, statuses, access, scope, provenance, completeness, baselines, and proposal dispositions.
The base-to-final diff contains exactly the five leased consolidated-review files and the worktree is clean.
The package reconciles 65 accounts, 499 evidence rows, 12 baselines, 576 blocked with zero ready or unmapped, and 30 recommend plus 8 hold plus 27 research-further proposals.
The output is body-free, has no em dashes, and grants no reviewed, canonical, best, viral, winner, generation, publishing, or canonical-write authority.

The exact verifier, npm run check, and git diff --check passed. Six independent mutations of lane status, per-category readiness, bridge total, global readiness, explicit ready/reviewed status, and summary blocked count all failed as expected.
